messages:
Tim S.: quick question — AcmeCo sent a SOC2 questionnaire addendum asking for log retention details and a list of subprocessors that have access to customer data. We need to respond by EOD. Anyone owning this?

Anita G.: I can take point on log redaction and retention. Is this for Hosted API only or also Dedicated/Private?

Tim S.: Hosted API only for this ask.

Riley K.: For Hosted we redact auth tokens and IPs at ingest and mask emails in traces. Example from our log-redact config:
```
redaction:
  patterns:
    - name: auth_token
      regex: "token=([A-Za-z0-9\-_.]+)"
      replace: "[REDACTED_TOKEN]"
    - name: email
      regex: "[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}"
      replace: "[EMAIL_HASHED]"
```
Retention: default logs 30d, traces 90d; we can export on request.

Jordan L.: For subprocessors, Legal maintains canonical list but Samir owns vendor registry. @Samir P. can you confirm which vendors have access to hosted logs/metrics?

Samir P.: On it — taking AcmeCo to the vendor review board. Current hosted stack: infra (CloudProvider), monitoring (Observy), SSO (AuthZero) — those have access to telemetry. I added a CSV snapshot to legal's drive.

sec-bot: Automated: If you need to export PII-containing logs, request access approval ticket #SEC-482 and include justification.

Anita G.: Also note encryption: transit TLS1.2+, at-rest AES-256. Hosted uses provider-managed KMS; Dedicated/Private can use CMEK/HSM. If AcmeCo requires customer-controlled keys we'll need contract + extra onboarding.

Riley K.: Add that we support field-level hashing for exported traces and can produce a redaction runbook for their review.

Jordan L.: I'll draft the answers (short bullets + config snippet) and tag you three for approvals before sending. Targeting a 3-paragraph response.

Tim S.: Awesome. Please CC legal on the final. Thanks team :pray:
